verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a 'training-data' page for connecting external knowledge sources and a Knowledge Base feature for hosting support content and runbooks, suggesting some support for knowledge grounding, but there is no concrete evidence of automated ingestion of help center content, past tickets, or internal wikis without manual re-authoring. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of connectors for help center/docs platforms, wiki integrations (Confluence/Notion), automatic ticket-history ingestion, and any hands-on evidence confirming these sources sync without manual re-entry.
